item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 28/May/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will bring heavy showers and squally thunderstorms to the coast of Guangdong today. The trough of low pressure is expected to move southwards slightly in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, a strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong. With the trough of low pressure edging closer to the coastal areas again towards the weekend, the weather will be unsettled over the region. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Ewiniar will move across the western North Pacific to the south of Japan in the next couple of days.
